Jack learned a lot about science. It takes twenty minutes to get to the plant garden by bike. Jack thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Best of all, water is our most important resource.
Jack and Nina had great fun there. Jack is reading a book about science. Jack bought a dress at the shop yesterday. A rainbow appeared after the rain.
Both of them like soup and coffee. Life is full of small surprises. Jack wants to be a teacher in the future. Swallows migrate south each autumn.
Jack hopes to visit Toronto one day. The weather was windy that day. The plant garden is one of the best places in the city.
